definitions.explanation: The series of vertebrae extending from the skull to the pelvis, enclosing the spinal cord and providing structural support.

examples.japanese: {脊椎|せきつい}を{真|ま}っすぐにして{座|すわ}る。
{脊椎|せきつい}{動物|どうぶつ}は{背骨|せぼね}を{持|も}つ。
{脊椎|せきつい}の{病気|びょうき}で{手術|しゅじゅつ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had surgery for a spinal condition.

notes:
{脊椎|せきつい} is the technical/medical term for the spine.

RELATED TERMS:
- {背骨|せぼね}: backbone (everyday word)
- {脊柱|せきちゅう}: spinal column (more technical)
- {脊髄|せきずい}: spinal cord
- {脊椎|せきつい}{動物|どうぶつ}: vertebrate

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {脊椎|せきつい}{損傷|そんしょう}: spinal injury
- {脊椎|せきつい}カリエス: spinal tuberculosis
